htn_kidney.title: CCL2 as a microvascular "tone breaker": inflammatory signaling and the failure of kidney autoregulation in salt-sensitive hypertension.
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：高血压相关的肾损伤很大程度上取决于肾脏缓冲传入小动脉的全身压力的能力。 临床提示：确定 C-C 基序趋化因子配体 2 作为 Dahl 盐敏感大鼠肾微血管平滑肌收缩力的直接调节剂。
htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertension-associated kidney injury is strongly shaped by the ability of the kidney to buffer systemic pressure at the afferent arteriole. Feng et al. identify C-C motif chemokine ligand 2 as a direct regulator of kidney microvascular smooth muscle contractility in Dahl salt-sensitive rats. Loss of C-C motif chemokine ligand 2 preserves Notch3-Mylk (myosin light-chain kinase) signaling, maintains myogenic tone, protects autoregulation, and prevents kidney injury. These findings position the C-C motif chemokine ligand 2/C-C motif chemokine receptor 2 axis as a mechanistic bridge between inflammatory signaling and hypertensive nephropathy.

portal_hypertension.title: Machine learning based hepatic safety score predicts decompensation in hepatocellular carcinoma systemic therapy.
portal_hypertension.authors: Han JW, Lee J, Yang K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 1262）。核心观点：肝细胞癌（HCC）经常与门静脉高压共存，显着增加全身治疗期间肝代偿失调（HD）和静脉曲张出血的风险。 临床提示：我们使用 2026 名不可切除的 HCC 患者的数据开发了基于机器学习的肝脏安全评分 (MHSS)，以预测具有临床意义的门静脉高压 (CSPH) 和预后。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) frequently coexists with portal hypertension, significantly increasing the risk of hepatic decompensation (HD) and variceal bleeding during systemic therapy. We developed a machine learning based hepatic safety score (MHSS) using data from 2026 patients with unresectable HCC to predict clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) and prognosis. A random forest model was trained in a derivation cohort (n = 1262) and validated in an independent cohort (n = 764). The MHSS demonstrated robust performance (AUROC 0.840) in CSPH and predicting HD. portal_hypertension.title: Efficacy and safety of post-Kasai steroid-based protocol in biliary atresia.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of pediatric gastroenterology and nutrition
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：Kaplan-Meier 分析证明 SG 的 24 个月 NLS 有所改善（对数秩 p = 0.044）。 临床提示：本研究旨在评估基于类固醇的治疗方案是否可以增强黄疸的清除并改善天然肝脏存活率（NLS）。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This study aims to assess whether steroid-based regimen enhances the clearance of jaundice and improves native liver survival (NLS). We included all infants with biliary atresia (BA) undergoing Kasai portoenterostomy (KPE) at our centre. The algorithm-initiated prednisolone was initiated if stools remained acholic. Of 127 infants, 70 formed the steroid group (SG) and 57 the historical cohort (HC). Jaundice clearance at 6 months was superior with steroids (61.4% vs. 38.6%; odds ratio [OR] 2.53, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.23-5.19, p = 0.013).
